title: Exact damping-basis continued fractions for few-atom lasers: collective correlations beyond second-order cumulant closure
abstract: We combine the Briegel--Englert damping basis of a lossy cavity mode with the permutation-invariant Liouville basis of \(N\) identical, incoherently pumped two-level emitters. The resulting Liouvillian is exactly block tridiagonal in a single radial field index, with atomic blocks of dimension \(\binom{N+3}{3}\). The stationary state follows from a matrix continued fraction whose asymptotic closure is a linear matrix equation that we prove to be uniquely solvable throughout the dissipative regime \(A>0\), and the same construction in the coherence-one sector yields the emission spectrum. The method is validated against direct diagonalization, weak-pump perturbation theory, and closed-system spectra, reaches \(N=16\) in tens of seconds in the few-quanta regime, and has a quantified precision limit at large photon number. We use it to derive an exact two-atom photon-balance identity that isolates the cavity-induced pair coherence and relates it to a singlet--triplet population difference; to establish an exact pump-order hierarchy of connected correlations for a zero-temperature cavity and a parity property of the minimal collective-spin sector; and to benchmark the second-order cumulant closure used in few-emitter laser theory, which we find to be semi-quantitative for the photon number but to predict the wrong sign of the inter-emitter coherence above inversion. In a good-cavity regime the exact solution shows near-Poissonian statistics and strong line narrowing for two and three emitters.

summaries.en: We present an exact damping-basis continued-fraction method for few-atom lasers that avoids second-order cumulant closure and reveals collective correlations such as cavity-induced pair coherence and a wrong-sign prediction of the cumulant approximation for inter-emitter coherence above inversion.
summaries.zh: 我们提出了一种少原子激光的精确阻尼基连分数方法，避免了二阶累积量截断，并揭示了集体关联，例如腔诱导的成对相干性以及累积量近似在反转以上对发射体间相干性给出的错误符号预测。
summaries.ja: 我々は少数原子レーザーに対する厳密な減衰基底連分数法を提示し、二次キュムラント閉鎖を回避して、空洞誘起の対コヒーレンスや反転以上の放出体間コヒーレンスに対するキュムラント近似の誤った符号予測などの集団相関を明らかにする。

title: Superconducting levitation and control of a high-reflectivity micromirror
abstract: We introduce a method to suspend an optical micromirror, with a total mass of \SI{30}{\micro\gram}, using superconducting magnetic levitation. The micromirror is formed on a silicon membrane, coated with a high-reflectivity dielectric stack and attached to superconducting microspheres. The object is stably levitated inside a magnetic quadrupole field at cryogenic temperatures. Magnetic feedback on the transverse motion is used to stabilize the position of the levitator within the trapping field, allowing to measure the axial displacement of the levitator using optical interferometry. The system reaches a sensitivity of order \SI{100}{\pico\metre/\sqrt{\hertz}} near the axial trap frequency of \SI{167}{Hz}. This approach enables free-standing mirrors with minimal dissipation and tunable oscillation frequencies, offering a platform for precision sensing and quantum cavity optomechanics in the microgram regime.

summaries.en: A 30-microgram high-reflectivity micromirror has been stably levitated by superconducting magnetic quadrupole trapping at cryogenic temperatures, with magnetic feedback stabilizing its transverse motion and optical interferometry resolving axial displacement at about 100 pm/√Hz near the 167 Hz trap frequency.
summaries.zh: 一个30微克的高反射率微镜在低温下通过超导磁四极场稳定悬浮，并利用横向磁反馈稳定其位置，光学干涉测量在167赫兹轴向俘获频率附近实现了约100皮米/√赫兹的位移灵敏度。
summaries.ja: 30マイクログラムの高反射率マイクロミラーを極低温で超伝導磁気四重極場により安定に浮遊させ、横方向の磁気フィードバックで位置を安定化しつつ、167 Hzの軸方向トラップ周波数付近で約100 pm/√Hzの変位感度を光干渉計で達成した。

title: Algorithmic Design of Heralded Linear Optical Circuits for Multipartite Entanglement
abstract: Heralded multipartite entanglement is a key resource for various quantum information tasks. However, designing linear optical circuits that generate specific target states is generally challenging due to the complexity of the required optical structures. Here we formulate the design of heralded photonic circuits as an algorithmic graph-search problem. Our framework enables the automated construction and optimization of heralded photonic circuits by substantially reducing the search space using the linear quantum graph (LQG) picture. Our strategy reconstructs circuit structures as graphs in the picture and identifies suitable graphs automatically. As a result, we design efficient schemes for a broad range of useful multipartite resource states, including hypergraph magic states, quantum error correcting codes, general three-qubit states and length-1 caterpillar graph states. Our work establishes an algorithmic framework for the systematic discovery of heralded resource states, laying the foundation for the automated design of increasingly complex multipartite entangled resources.

summaries.en: This work formulates the design of heralded linear optical circuits for multipartite entanglement as an algorithmic graph-search problem within the linear quantum graph picture, enabling automated discovery of efficient schemes for resource states such as hypergraph magic states, quantum error correcting codes, general three-qubit states, and length-1 caterpillar graph states.
summaries.zh: 该工作将用于多体纠缠的预示型线性光学电路设计表述为线性量子图框架下的算法图搜索问题，从而能够自动发现针对超图魔态、量子纠错码、一般三量子比特态和长度1毛毛虫图态等资源态的高效方案。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、多体エンタングルメントのためのヘラルド線形光学回路の設計を線形量子グラフ描像におけるアルゴリズム的グラフ探索問題として定式化し、ハイパーグラフマジック状態、量子誤り訂正符号、一般的な3量子ビット状態、長さ1のキャタピラーグラフ状態などのリソース状態に対する効率的なスキームの自動発見を可能にする。

title: Sublattice-selective control of spin reversal in metasurface-coupled Kagome interfaces
abstract: Coherent manipulation of photonic interface states requires a control field that matches their internal mode structure. We study this requirement in a two-component Kagome lattice motivated by photon-mediated exchange near a nonlinear nonlocal metasurface. The Dirac spinors show why uniform Raman control cannot couple opposite-spin, same-valley interface modes at leading order, even when their spatial envelopes coincide. A $1:1:-2$ sublattice pattern removes this cancellation and maximizes the projected coupling at fixed root-mean-square amplitude within the diagonal-control class. We test this control scheme through full-zone topology and complete lattice propagation. For a smooth, gapped interface, a $720$-dimensional calculation gives target-mode fidelity $0.999937$ with leakage $6.27\times10^{-5}$ at RMS drive $0.04t$. Trace-preserving dynamics gives the separate survival condition needed for successful conversion. An exploratory three-dimensional lithium-niobate supercell reproduces the complex addressing pattern with $0.373\%$ relative error and provides nonlocal exchange, decay and electro-optic frequency-conversion matrices. The mode-resolved control principle thus gives quantitative electromagnetic design targets; the full spin-dependent device realization still requires further calibration.

summaries.en: A sublattice-selective 1:1:-2 control pattern overcomes the leading-order cancellation that prevents uniform Raman driving from coupling opposite-spin, same-valley interface modes in a metasurface-coupled Kagome lattice, achieving target-mode fidelity of 0.
summaries.zh: 在超表面耦合的Kagome晶格中，子晶格选择性的1:1:-2控制模式克服了均匀拉曼驱动无法在最低阶耦合相反自旋、同一谷界面模式的相消问题，在低驱动幅度下实现了0.
summaries.ja: メタサーフェス結合カゴメ格子において、サブ格子選択的な1:1:-2制御パターンが、均一ラマン駆動では最低次で結合できない逆スピン・同一谷界面モードの相殺を克服し、低駆動振幅で目標モード忠実度0.

title: Optical Quantum Computing
abstract: Under the label of optical quantum computing, there are a variety of protocols and experiments that use the quantum properties of light to achieve a computational advantage over classical computing machines. In this review, we describe some of the main implementations, which differ in the type of encoding and in how the computation is performed, whether using gates or cluster states. For each protocol, we describe advantages and challenges with an overview of the experimental results obtained, summarized in tables. Because of the great relevance achieved in this field, there is a section dedicated to non-universal quantum computation with photons, where boson sampling, variational quantum eigensolvers, and quantum machine learning applications are described. The aim is to give the reader the broadest overview of the applications where photons and their quantum properties play a key role in computation.

summaries.en: This review surveys protocols and experiments in optical quantum computing that harness the quantum properties of light for computational advantage, covering different encoding types and gate- or cluster-state-based approaches, along with non-universal applications such as boson sampling, variational quantum eigensolvers, and quantum machine learning.
summaries.zh: 这篇综述梳理了利用光的量子特性取得计算优势的光学量子计算协议与实验，涵盖不同的编码方式以及基于门或簇态的计算方法，并介绍了玻色采样、变分量子本征求解器和量子机器学习等非通用量子计算应用。
summaries.ja: 本レビューは、光の量子特性を利用して計算上の優位性を得る光量子コンピューティングのプロトコルと実験を概観し、異なるエンコーディングやゲート方式・クラスター状態方式の計算手法に加え、ボソンサンプリング、変分量子固有値ソルバー、量子機械学習といった非汎用量子計算への応用を紹介する。

title: A Programmable Rydberg Quantum Bus for Nonlocal Connectivity
abstract: Scalable quantum networks require processing nodes with flexible internal connectivity, yet neutral-atom architectures remain constrained by the strong spatial dependence of native Rydberg interactions. Here we show that a Rydberg atom chain can act as a coherent quantum bus, converting a locally connected one-dimensional architecture into an effectively nonlocal interaction network. Virtual excitations in the dispersive regime mediate controllable interactions between spatially separated data units, which we derive analytically using a Green's-function continued-fraction method. The resulting mechanism is not restricted to single-excitation dynamics and supports several distinct functionalities, including Floquet-engineered chiral transport, remote entanglement of mechanical oscillators, and destructive interference for selectively suppressing unwanted dipole exchange. Simulations incorporating full long-range Rydberg interactions, atomic position fluctuations, and finite Rydberg-state lifetimes show that the mediated dynamics remain robust under experimentally relevant conditions. These results establish Rydberg chains as programmable coherent mediators for extending the internal connectivity of neutral-atom quantum nodes toward quasi-all-to-all coupling, providing a hardware-level route toward scalable and reconfigurable quantum-network architectures.

summaries.en: A Rydberg atom chain can serve as a coherent quantum bus that converts a locally connected one-dimensional neutral-atom architecture into an effectively nonlocal interaction network via virtual excitations in the dispersive regime, enabling functionalities such as Floquet-engineered chiral transport, remote entanglement of mechanical oscillators, and selective suppression of dipole exchange, while remaining robust under full long-range interactions, position fluctuations, and finite Rydberg-state lifetimes.
summaries.zh: 里德堡原子链可作为相干量子总线，通过色散区域中的虚激发将局域连接的一维中性原子架构转化为有效非局域相互作用网络，支持Floquet工程手性输运、机械振子远程纠缠以及选择性抑制偶极交换等功能，并在完整长程里德堡相互作用、原子位置涨落和有限里德堡态寿命下保持鲁棒。
summaries.ja: リドベルグ原子鎖はコヒーレント量子バスとして機能し、分散領域における仮想励起を介して局所的に結合した一次元中性原子アーキテクチャを実効的な非局所相互作用ネットワークへ変換し、フロケ工学によるカイラル輸送、機械振動子の遠隔もつれ、双極子交換の選択的抑制などの機能を可能にするとともに、完全な長距離リドベルグ相互作用、原子位置揺らぎ、有限のリドベルグ状態寿命の下でも頑健であることを示す。

title: Programmable Hong--Ou--Mandel interference in a giant-atom beam splitter
abstract: The Hong--Ou--Mandel (HOM) effect is a hallmark of two-photon quantum interference, in which two indistinguishable photons impinging on a balanced beam splitter bunch into the same output port. Here, we show that a giant atom (GA), coupled to two waveguides through two coupling points each, can function as a programmable HOM interferometer, enabling continuous control over single-photon beam splitting and two-photon interference. This programmability arises from coupling-phase differences in the GA, which tune its self-interference and directionality, and thereby its scattering response. To characterize the two-photon interference, we analyze the scattering of two Gaussian single-photon wave packets injected through different waveguides and evaluate the bunching and antibunching (coincidence) probabilities of the resulting four output ports. At the operating point where the GA acts as an effective 50:50 beam splitter for single photons, we observe a pronounced HOM dip as the relative input delay between the two wave packets is varied. Away from this point, adjusting the coupling phases continuously tunes the two-photon output statistics between bunching into the same output port and antibunching across distinct output ports. In addition, we explore an application to quantum parameter estimation, showing that small deviations of coupling phases can be estimated from the two-photon output statistics, with the achievable sensitivity quantified by the classical Fisher information associated with a binary coincidence measurement. Our giant-atom beam splitter thus provides a programmable platform for two-photon interference in waveguide quantum electrodynamics, with potential applications in quantum information processing, quantum communication, and quantum sensing.

summaries.en: A giant atom coupled to two waveguides through two coupling points each can act as a programmable Hong-Ou-Mandel interferometer, where coupling-phase differences continuously tune single-photon beam splitting and two-photon interference, enabling bunching or antibunching and quantum parameter estimation.
summaries.zh: 一个通过两个耦合点分别与两条波导耦合的巨原子可以充当可编程的Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉仪，其中耦合相位差连续调节单光子分束和双光子干涉，实现聚束或反聚束以及量子参数估计。
summaries.ja: 二つの導波路にそれぞれ二つの結合点で結合したジャイアント原子は、プログラマブルなHong-Ou-Mandel干渉計として機能し、結合位相差が単一光子ビーム分割と二光子干渉を連続的に制御してバンチングまたはアンチバンチングを実現し、量子パラメータ推定を可能にする。

title: Giant-atom-mediated photon blockade
abstract: Photon blockade is a phenomenon where the presence of system nonlinearity causes the output to consist of single photons, which has been extensively studied in point atom systems, but it is barely explored in giant atom ones. In this paper, we propose giant atom-mediated photon blockade scheme based on two cavities and three cavities systems with driving field applied to the first cavity. We show that simultaneous unconventional photon blockades (UPBs) can not occur in the point atom system (the atom coupling only to the leftmost cavity) due to there always existing a cavity to have a single path. In contrast, the spatially extended nature of giant atom enables coupling to multiple cavities and allows for the introduction of a phase and coupling strength. Consequently, simultaneous UPBs in multiple cavities can be obtained due to the multipath destructive interference. Moreover, by manipulating the detuning, we observe simultaneous conventional photon blockades (CPBs) in multiple cavities. Finally, we study simultaneous two-photon blockades (2PBs) in point atom multiple cavities system.

summaries.en: The paper proposes giant-atom-mediated photon blockade schemes in two- and three-cavity systems, showing that the giant atom's spatially extended coupling to multiple cavities enables simultaneous unconventional photon blockades via multipath destructive interference, tunable simultaneous conventional photon blockades through detuning manipulation, and simultaneous two-photon blockades in a point-atom multi-cavity system.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了基于双腔和三腔系统的巨原子介导的光子阻塞方案，表明巨原子的空间延展耦合能够通过多路径破坏性干涉实现多腔同时非传统光子阻塞，通过失谐调控实现多腔同时传统光子阻塞，并在点原子多腔系统中实现同时双光子阻塞。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、2空洞および3空洞系における巨大原子媒介光子ブロッケード方案を提案し、巨大原子の空間的に広がった結合が多経路の破壊的干渉を通じて複数空洞での同時非従来型光子ブロッケードを可能にし、離調操作により同時従来型光子ブロッケードを実現し、さらに点原子多空洞系における同時二光子ブロッケードを達成することを示した。

title: Filter-Free Indistinguishable Photon Generation from Continuous-Wave-Driven Integrated Microresonators
abstract: Quantum networks require scalable photon sources combining narrow linewidth, high efficiency, and high indistinguishability. Microresonator photon-pair sources are promising candidates, yet a source-only description based on the joint spectral amplitude (JSA) predicts near-zero Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility between photons generated by independent, CW-driven microresonators. In this work, we show that the observed HOM interference is not determined by the JSA alone. By combining finite-time detection with cavity-enhanced spontaneous four-wave mixing, we characterize a detector-conditioned heralded state governed by the idler-photon detection window. We further demonstrate that independently optimizing the idler and signal detection windows allows both heralded-photon indistinguishability and intrinsic heralding efficiency to approach unity, without spectral filtering or complex source engineering. Utilizing integrated high-$Q$ silicon nitride microresonators, we achieve HOM visibilities of 0.992(8) and 0.942(12), without background subtraction, at fourfold count rates of 4.5(3) and 12.2(6) Hz, respectively. Our work establishes CW-driven high-$Q$ microresonators as a robust and scalable platform for quantum-network primitives.

summaries.en: By combining finite-time detection with cavity-enhanced spontaneous four-wave mixing, independently optimizing idler and signal detection windows enables near-unity heralded-photon indistinguishability and intrinsic heralding efficiency from continuous-wave-driven integrated microresonators without spectral filtering.
summaries.zh: 通过将有限时间探测与腔增强自发四波混频相结合，独立优化闲频光和信号光的探测窗口，可以在无需光谱滤波的情况下，使连续波驱动的集成微谐振器产生的预告光子不可区分性和内在预告效率接近单位值。
summaries.ja: 有限時間検出と共振器増強自发四光波混合を組み合わせ、アイドラー光とシグナル光の検出窓を独立に最適化することで、スペクトルフィルタリングなしに連続波駆動集積マイクロ共振器からの heralded 光子の不可区別性と内在的 heralding 効率をほぼ1にできる。

title: Theory-agnostic nonclassicality certification in an integrated photonic circuit
abstract: Certifying nonclassicality without assuming any particular underlying physical theory constitutes both a foundational challenge and a requirement for device-independent protocols. Realizing such theory-independent certification in scalable architectures is essential for connecting fundamental tests with emerging quantum technologies. Integrated photonic circuits are a leading platform for scalable quantum information processing, motivating the development of rigorous methods to certify the nonclassical resources underpinning quantum advantage. In this paper, we report a theory-independent certification of generalized contextuality on a three-mode integrated photonic circuit. Our approach combines theory-agnostic tomography with simplex-embeddability certification---a framework that requires no assumptions about the underlying physical theory---and applies it to experimental data from a three-mode photonic circuit seeded by single photons. An independently constructed quantum model of the experiment provides a consistency check on the observed nonclassicality, without entering the certification as a theoretical assumption. The method rules out simplex-embeddability for our experimental data, providing robust, theory-independent evidence that our photonic circuit exhibits nonclassicality.

summaries.en: This paper reports a theory-agnostic certification of generalized contextuality in a three-mode integrated photonic circuit by combining theory-independent tomography with simplex-embeddability certification on single-photon experimental data, ruling out simplex-embeddability and thus providing theory-independent evidence of nonclassicality.
summaries.zh: 本文通过将理论无关的层析技术与单纯形可嵌入性认证相结合，对由单光子驱动的三模集成光子电路的实验数据进行了认证，排除了单纯形可嵌入性，从而提供了该光子电路表现出非经典性的理论无关证据。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、理論に依存しないトモグラフィーと単体埋め込み可能性の認証を組み合わせ、単一光子で駆動された3モード集積フォトニック回路の実験データに適用することで単体埋め込み可能性を排除し、このフォトニック回路が非古典性を示すという理論非依存の証拠を与える。

title: Liouvillian exceptional points in the emergence of quantum synchronization
abstract: The coupling between self-sustained oscillators, such as lasers or polariton condensates, leads to different steady-states in different regimes. Weak coupling allows the oscillators to behave independently, with different frequencies and uncorrelated phases, while stronger coupling can produce synchronization. In classical or semiclassical theories transitions between these steady-states correspond to changes in the topology of the phase space attractors and occur at generalized exceptional points. We investigate the corresponding changes in a quantum theory of coupled lasers or condensates. We show how the different steady-state regimes of the classical limit give rise to distinct forms for the spectra and eigenmatrices of the slow modes of the Liouvillian. By following the spectral flow between the different regimes we show that the synchronization transition is controlled by cascades of exceptional points in these slow modes, protected by a generalized PT symmetry. Our results show how singularities of the quantum Liouvillian control the different dynamical regimes, and give rise to experimental signatures of the synchronization transition which remain well-defined in the few-particle regime dominated by quantum effects.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: The synchronization transition in coupled quantum oscillators such as lasers or polariton condensates is controlled by cascades of Liouvillian exceptional points in the slow modes, protected by a generalized PT symmetry, yielding experimental signatures that persist in the few-particle quantum regime.
summaries.zh: 激光器或极化激元凝聚体等耦合量子振子的同步相变由慢模式中受广义PT对称性保护的刘维尔奇异点级联所控制，从而在少粒子量子区域也能产生可实验观测的同步相变特征。
summaries.ja: レーザーやポラリトン凝縮体などの結合量子振動子における同期転移は、一般化PT対称性に保護された低速モードのリウヴィリア例外点のカスケードによって制御され、少数粒子の量子領域でも実験的に観測可能な同期転移の兆候を与える。

title: Entanglement swapping across a five-node relay in a multiplexed quantum-classical network
abstract: Quantum networks are resources for scaling quantum computers and distributed sensing technologies while offering post-quantum security benefits. Teleporting non-classical resources like entanglement, via so called entanglement swapping, is essential for networks in particular overcoming rate-loss limits via quantum repeaters. Deploying these systems on real infrastructure will likely require multiplexing photonic qubits into fibers carrying 'classical' light encoding standard Internet communications and control plane signals for multi-node quantum protocols. Here, we report the first demonstration of entanglement swapping and conventional communications operating over the same fibers. Entanglement is swapped across a five-node quantum relay topology connected by four long-distance fibers, each populated with classical data signals. Time-bin entangled photons in the C-band are multiplexed alongside C-band classical signals using dense-wavelength division multiplexing, introducing noise photons generated by high-power classical light. We experimentally and theoretically characterize the trade-off between quantum fidelity and Raman noise photons. Entanglement swapping is demonstrated over a maximum fiber length of 40 km (four 10-km fibers) while simultaneously transmitting 10-Gbps classical data through all fibers. These results represent a significant advancement in the demonstrated complexity of coexisting quantum and classical networks and provide a roadmap for achieving the widespread deployment of advanced quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper reports the first demonstration of entanglement swapping across a five-node quantum relay connected by four long-distance fibers while simultaneously transmitting 10-Gbps classical data through all fibers via dense-wavelength division multiplexing, characterizing the trade-off between quantum fidelity and Raman noise photons.
summaries.zh: 该论文首次展示了在由四条长距离光纤连接的五节点量子中继上实现纠缠交换，同时通过密集波分复用在所有光纤中传输10 Gbps经典数据，并刻画了量子保真度与拉曼噪声光子之间的权衡。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、4本の長距離ファイバで接続された5ノード量子リレー上でのエンタングルメントスワッピングを、高密度波長分割多重を用いて全ファイバで10 Gbpsの古典データを同時伝送しながら初めて実証し、量子忠実度とラマン雑音光子のトレードオフを特徴付けた。

title: Logarithmic-depth quantum simulation of boson sampling
abstract: We show that boson sampling with an arbitrary $m$-mode interferometer and $n\le m$ single-photon inputs can be simulated to inverse-polynomial total-variation error by a logarithmic-depth qubit circuit with polynomially many qubits. The circuit uses Clifford+$T$ gates, arbitrary qubit connectivity, and a single final measurement, and its family is logspace uniform. The key idea is to enlarge the optical system, decompose the resulting transformation into six quadratic shears, and distribute each mode over many submodes. This redistribution permits a fixed local occupation cutoff, after which local basis changes and parallel phase gates give the qubit circuit. Consequently, our result places boson sampling within shallow quantum computation.

summaries.en: Boson sampling with an arbitrary m-mode interferometer and n ≤ m single-photon inputs can be simulated to inverse-polynomial total-variation error by a logspace-uniform, logarithmic-depth Clifford+T qubit circuit with polynomially many qubits and arbitrary connectivity, placing boson sampling within shallow quantum computation.
summaries.zh: 具有任意 m 模干涉仪和 n ≤ m 个单光子输入的玻色采样，可由一个对数深度、logspace 一致的 Clifford+T 量子比特电路以多项式数量的量子比特模拟到反多项式总变差误差，从而将玻色采样置于浅层量子计算之内。
summaries.ja: 任意のmモード干渉計とn ≤ m個の単一光子入力を用いたボソンサンプリングは、多項式個の量子ビットを用いたlogspace一様な対数深さのClifford+T量子回路により逆多項式の全変動誤差でシミュレートでき、ボソンサンプリングが浅い量子計算に含まれることを示す。

title: Continuous variable distributed quantum sensing in integrated photonics
abstract: Distributed quantum sensing is an emerging application of quantum networking, where entangled probe states are employed to sense combinations of delocalized parameters with enhanced precision relative to using separable states. Squeezed states of light are a prime resource for experimental demonstrations of entanglement-enhanced sensing, because they can be generated and entangled deterministically. Existing distributed quantum sensing experiments have been fundamentally limited in scalability due to their bulk-optic architectures. Meanwhile, integrated photonics provides a scalable and compact platform for quantum sensors. Here we demonstrate entanglement-enhanced sensing of linear functions of four phase shifts in an integrated photonic circuit. We find an entanglement-enhanced precision of 0.199(16) dB below the shot noise limit compared to 0.041(18) dB for separable states. A four-mode entangled state is generated on-chip with entanglement verification and phase sensing also performed on-chip with an array of four integrated homodyne detectors.

summaries.en: Entanglement-enhanced distributed quantum sensing of linear combinations of four phase shifts is demonstrated in an integrated photonic circuit using an on-chip four-mode entangled squeezed state and an array of four integrated homodyne detectors.
summaries.zh: 本文在集成光子芯片上演示了纠缠增强的分布式量子传感，利用片上生成的四模纠缠压缩态和四个集成零差探测器，实现了对四个相位移动线性组合的测量。
summaries.ja: 集積フォトニクス回路において、オンチップ生成した4モード圧縮エンタングル状態と4つの集積ホモダイン検出器を用い、4つの位相シフトの線形結合に対するエンタングルメント増強分散量子センシングを実証した。

title: Physically Consistent Modeling of Dispersive Time-Modulated Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for Wideband OFDM
abstract: The elements of a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) are commonly modeled either as frequency-selective time-invariant reflectors or as instantaneous time-varying reflection coefficients. In practice, however, time-modulated metasurfaces exhibit both frequency selectivity and periodic time variation. We develop a physically consistent linear periodically time-varying (LPTV) model that jointly captures these effects and characterizes their impact on wideband orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) communications. From a canonical equivalent circuit of a generic RIS element, we derive a single-resonance model whose physically meaningful parameters determine both the frequency-selective reflection coefficient and the effective impulse-response duration, i.e., the finite memory of the element. The periodically switched dispersive responses are then represented through harmonic transfer functions, leading to a closed-form per-subcarrier OFDM input-output relation. The resulting coupling is generally non-diagonal: each received subcarrier collects contributions from multiple transmitted subcarriers through the RIS harmonics, each weighted by the element response at the corresponding absolute input frequency. We further derive a generalized cyclic-prefix (CP) condition requiring the guard interval to accommodate both the propagation-channel delay spread and the RIS memory. Under this condition, intersymbol interference and out-of-grid spectral leakage are suppressed, while deterministic on-grid harmonic coupling remains. Full-wave simulations of an OpenRIS unit cell designed for a 5G NR channel validate the proposed resonant model and reveal appreciable in-band dispersion despite nearly ideal binary phase switching. Simulations over 3GPP tapped-delay-line (TDL) channels confirm the generalized CP condition and show its relevance for high-quality-factor RIS elements.

summaries.en: A physically consistent linear periodically time-varying model of dispersive time-modulated reconfigurable intelligent surfaces is developed from an equivalent-circuit single-resonance description to derive closed-form per-subcarrier OFDM input-output relations and a generalized cyclic-prefix condition that accommodates both channel delay spread and RIS memory.
summaries.zh: 本文从等效电路的单谐振描述出发，建立了一种物理一致的色散时间调制可重构智能表面线性周期时变模型，推导出闭式的OFDM逐子载波输入输出关系，以及同时容纳信道时延扩展和RIS记忆的广义循环前缀条件。
summaries.ja: 等価回路の単一共振記述から、分散性時間変調再構成可能知能表面の物理的に整合した線形周期時変モデルを構築し、OFDMのサブキャリアごとの閉形式入出力関係と、伝搬路遅延広がりとRISメモリの両方を許容する一般化サイクリックプレフィックス条件を導出した。

title: Reconfigurable Holographic Surface for Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer
abstract: In this paper, we propose to use a novel reconfigurable holographic surface (RHS) to improve the performance of simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) by exploiting the additional spatial degrees of freedom (DoFs) enabled by the holographic interference principle. Specifically, we study an RHS-empowered SWIPT system in which the digital beamformer at the base station (BS) and the holographic beamformer at the RHS are jointly optimized to maximize the weighted sum-rate of information-decoding (ID) users while guaranteeing a minimum harvested energy requirement for each energy-harvesting (EH) user. Due to the non-convexity of the optimization problem, the weighted sum-rate maximization problem is challenging to solve. We first adopt the weighted minimum mean squared error (WMMSE) method to transform the objective into a more tractable form. We then develop an iterative optimization framework, where the BS digital beamforming and the RHS holographic beamforming subproblems are solved via the majorization-minimization (MM) method. Since solving each subproblem can incur prohibitive complexity as the variable dimension increases, we further propose low-complexity solutions for the two subproblems based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) methodology. Numerical results validate the convergence behavior of the proposed algorithms and demonstrate that the RHS-aided BS achieves significant performance gains over a conventional fully-digital BS benchmark. Moreover, the proposed low-complexity algorithms substantially reduce computational complexity while maintaining nearly the same performance.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a reconfigurable holographic surface (RHS) to enhance simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) by jointly optimizing base station digital beamforming and RHS holographic beamforming to maximize the weighted sum-rate of information-decoding users while meeting each energy-harvesting user's minimum harvested energy requirement, using WMMSE, majorization-minimization, and ADMM-based low-complexity algorithms.
summaries.zh: 本文提出利用一种新型可重构全息表面（RHS）来提升同时无线信息与能量传输（SWIPT）的性能，通过联合优化基站数字波束成形和RHS全息波束成形，在保证每个能量收集用户最低收集能量需求的同时最大化信息解码用户的加权和速率，并采用WMMSE、主化最小化及基于ADMM的低复杂度算法求解。
summaries.ja: 本論文では、新規の再構成可能ホログラフィック表面（RHS）を用いて同時無線情報・電力伝送（SWIPT）の性能を向上させることを提案し、基地局のデジタルビームフォーミングとRHSのホログラフィックビームフォーミングを共同最適化して、各エネルギー収集ユーザの最低収集エネルギー要件を満たしつつ情報復号ユーザの重み付き和レートを最大化するために、WMMSE、主化最小化、およびADMMに基づく低複雑度アルゴリズムを適用する。

title: FreqTune-PASS: Frequency-Tuned Beamforming for Multi-User Pinching-Antenna Systems
abstract: Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) reconfigure large-scale propagation environments by activating low-cost radiation points along a dielectric waveguide. However, existing multi-user PASS designs rely on pinching-antenna (PA) position optimization or activation, whose mechanical reconfiguration is much slower than user switching in time-division multiple access systems. To overcome this mismatch, a frequency-tuned beamforming framework (FreqTune-PASS) is proposed, where all PA positions remain fixed and only a user-specific carrier-frequency offset is adjusted in each slot. Since each PA-radiated signal experiences a distinct combination of in-waveguide and free-space delays, a common frequency offset induces path-specific phase rotations and thus reshapes the coherent superposition at the scheduled user. Based on a delay-domain system model, the fast-timescale frequency-offset optimization and the slow-timescale PA-deployment problems are formulated. A closed-form globally optimal offset is derived for the two-PA case, while a low-complexity one-dimensional search and an approximate closed-form offset under equal-spacing deployment are developed for the multi-PA case. The deployment analysis further shows that full-aperture equal spacing maximizes the guaranteed phase-tuning span and yields near-arithmetic relative delays for uniformly distributed users. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves both the sum rate and the worst-user rate over fixed-frequency transmission and approaches the coherent-combining upper bound.

summaries.en: FreqTune-PASS is a frequency-tuned beamforming framework for multi-user pinching-antenna systems that keeps all pinching-antenna positions fixed and adjusts only a user-specific carrier-frequency offset per slot to reshape the coherent signal superposition at the scheduled user, substantially improving sum and worst-user rates over fixed-frequency transmission.
summaries.zh: FreqTune-PASS 是一种面向多用户夹持天线系统的频率调谐波束成形框架，它保持所有夹持天线位置固定，仅在每个时隙调整用户特定的载波频率偏移，以重塑被调度用户处的相干信号叠加，从而相对于固定频率传输显著提升总和速率与最差用户速率。
summaries.ja: FreqTune-PASSは、マルチユーザ・ピンチングアンテナシステムにおいて全ピンチングアンテナ位置を固定したまま各スロットでユーザ固有のキャリア周波数オフセットのみを調整し、スケジュールされたユーザでのコヒーレント信号重ね合わせを再形成することで、固定周波数伝送に比べて総和レートと最悪ユーザレートを大幅に改善する周波数チューニングビームフォーミングフレームワークである。
